Site Reliability Engineering

Burn Rate

The rate at which error budget or SLO allowance is consumed over time, indicating the pace of reliability degradation in SRE practice and the urgency of corrective actions.

Questions and answers

What is Burn Rate?

In this glossary, Burn Rate refers to: The rate at which error budget or SLO allowance is consumed over time, indicating the pace of reliability degradation in SRE practice and the urgency of corrective actions.

How is Burn Rate used in IT and DevOps?

In IT and DevOps communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cuando el burn rate supera el umbral aceptable, los equipos SRE deben pausar los lanzamientos arriesgados y abordar las causas subyacentes para proteger la fiabilidad."

Definition

The rate at which error budget or SLO allowance is consumed over time, indicating the pace of reliability degradation in SRE practice and the urgency of corrective actions.

Operational example

When burn rate exceeds the acceptable threshold, SRE teams must pause risky releases and address the underlying causes to protect reliability.
